reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Designs developer activation around a measurable first-value event, short verified quickstarts, progressive examples, recoverable errors, maintained templates, persona testing, funnel instrumentation, and behavior-sensitive follow-up.
neutralIntentExamples: reduce the elapsed time from signup to a meaningful first API result
build a minimal-to-production sample ladder whose examples stay continuously tested
inputs: developer personas, product value event, current signup and quickstart flow, environments, prerequisites, errors, samples, telemetry, and retention outcomes
privacy consent, accessibility, cost, email authority, template ownership, current SDK versions, and representative usability participants
operations: define one observable first-value and activation event from the developer's outcome rather than an internal milestone
time a clean-room onboarding path across personas and catalog every dependency, confusion point, failure, and recovery
ship the smallest verified quickstart and maintained example ladder, then compare activation and retention cohorts under consented measurement
outputs: friction inventory, activation funnel, and maintenance plan
failureBehavior: requires expected output, prerequisites, recovery guidance, template health, and cohort measurement
uses unsourced benchmarks and vendor examples and proposes recording, analytics, and email without a complete consent or experimental-integrity contract
exclusions: does not optimize only for the first API call when it has no user value
does not send lifecycle messages without communication authority
does not publish untested sample code
usefulInvariants: first value is externally observable
every quickstart command has a current clean-room proof
follow-up stops after activation
materialRisks: telemetry can expose developer behavior and credentials
